lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Reset application data and launch once
verify Local project is already active and add one local feature
import and switch to a Web GIS project then return to Local project
upgrade an installation that has a legacy default map with one local layer and verify it appears once as Local project while the previously active valid project stays active
Open Settings then Project and verify Web GIS name/account/id/district
start synchronization and attempt to import another Collector project
delete a Web GIS project with one unsynchronized NGW layer
then delete the last remaining project
value.expected: A clean install opens inside a registered Local project and legacy standalone data is copied once without deleting its source; local projects contain their own OSM/tracks/data; aliases persist and stay unique; import during synchronization warns and offers interruption before creating the project entry; successful delete reports success, removes only the device workspace and never Web GIS/account data; unsynchronized NGW data is backed up and backup failure cancels deletion; deleting the last project opens a new empty local fallback.
